## Earnie 2.5.3-alpha.6

Community **pre-release** of the **2.5.3** line (follow-up to `2.5.3-alpha.5`). Focus: HA add-on Ingress **start crash** after the nginx path fix.

### Highlights

- **Ingress start fix** — add-on `run.sh` no longer uses a broken GNU `sed` escape that aborted start with `unterminated 's' command` when `ingress_entry` was present (`set -e`)
- Nginx conf is rendered with Python `str.replace` for `__INGRESS_ENTRY__`
- Dogfood: update the HA add-on to **2.5.3-alpha.6**, then OPEN WEB UI via Ingress on Synology HAOS

### Docker images

- `ghcr.io/jochentcc/earnie-energy:2.5.3-alpha.6` only (**no** `:latest`)
- Alpha compose: `docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml` / `loxberry-alpha.yml` / `proxmox-alpha.yml` (already pin this tag)

Multi-arch: `linux/amd64` (Synology / Proxmox) · `linux/arm64` (LoxBerry).

```bash
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml pull
docker compose --project-directory . -f docker/compose/synology-alpha.yml up -d
```

Prod `*_productive.yml` with `:latest` stays on the last official (**2.5.2**).
